Title: Asset Register table causes horizontal viewport overflow on mobile (320px)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open /dashboard on viewport width 320px.
2. Observe page horizontal scroll width exceeding viewport.
Expected Behavior: Table cards stack vertically or table container has dedicated overflow-x: auto wrapper without pushing full page width.
Suggested Resolution: Wrap table in an overflow-x: auto container or use card-based layout on screens < 768px.

Title: Add Asset form causes horizontal page overflow at 320px
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Open /dashboard/add-product on viewport width 320px.
2. Observe horizontal scroll on the entire page.
Expected Behavior: Form controls stretch 100% of available container width without extending beyond 100vw.
Actual Behavior: Horizontal page scrolling observed on 320px viewport.
Suggested Resolution: Set form-center grid min-width: 0 and inputs width: 100% with box-sizing: border-box.

Title: Icon-only header & navigation buttons missing aria-label or accessible text (WCAG 4.1.2)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Tab through header icon buttons (ThemeToggle, Sidebar collapse).
2. Inspect accessibility tree in browser DevTools.
Expected Behavior: All interactive icon buttons provide an aria-label, title, or sr-only text describing their function.
Actual Behavior: Buttons contain bare SVG paths without accessible name, announced as "button" with no label by screen readers.
Suggested Resolution: Add aria-label="Toggle color theme", aria-label="Toggle navigation menu", and aria-label="Close dialog" to icon buttons.

Title: Keyboard focus ring lacks sufficient contrast / relies on subtle box-shadow (WCAG 2.4.7)
Affected Screen: Global Form Controls & Buttons (Login, Register, Add Asset, Modals)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Press Tab key across form inputs on /login, /register, and /dashboard/add-product.
2. Observe element border/outline upon focus.
Expected Behavior: A 2px solid high-contrast outline (>= 3:1 contrast ratio against adjacent canvas) is visible around the active control.
Actual Behavior: Outline is suppressed (outline: none); focus state relies on subtle 1px border or faint box-shadow that blends into light/dark backgrounds.
Suggested Resolution: Add CSS rule: *:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

Title: Status badge colors convey state with low contrast in Dark Mode (WCAG 1.4.3)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Switch to Dark Theme via header.
2. Inspect status badges ("In-Use", "Available", "Under Repair") on asset cards.
Expected Behavior: Text color on badge background maintains >= 4.5:1 contrast ratio in both Light and Dark themes.
Actual Behavior: Badges keep hardcoded light-theme green/amber/red pastel backgrounds in dark mode, creating low contrast against light card backgrounds in dark theme.
Suggested Resolution: Define theme-aware CSS variables for badge backgrounds and text (e.g. var(--badge-success-bg), var(--badge-success-text)).

Title: Pagination and search query states lose scroll anchor on mobile filter change
Steps to Reproduce:
1. On viewport width <= 390px, scroll down past the SearchContainer.
2. Tap a status filter or clear button.
Expected Behavior: Filter updates results smoothly while maintaining user context or scrolling to top of results.
Actual Behavior: Full-page layout shifts abruptly and window jumps to header, requiring the user to scroll down again.
Suggested Resolution: Use smooth scroll or preserve window scroll position on search parameter updates.
